The LAP Ubertas Fixed LED Downlight provides versatile and efficient illumination for modern interiors. Featuring a sleek polished chrome bezel and an integrated LED driver, this unit offers tunable colour temperatures, allowing selection from a warm 2700K to a bright 6000K daylight. It is fully dimmable, providing flexible light control. With an IP65 rating and high CRI 90, it is particularly suitable for bathroom zone 2 installations, kitchens, or general home lighting, ensuring accurate colour representation and durability.
